# Scope: a company. Resets one good slot of te_pa_gen_assess's readings.
te_pa_gen_clear_good = {
	set_variable = { name = te_pa_g_$SLOT$_good value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = te_pa_g_$SLOT$_pricier value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = te_pa_g_$SLOT$_imported value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = te_pa_g_$SLOT$_exported value = 0 }
}

# Scope: a company. Reads one good of its sector in its owner's market: the index, the signed price over
# base (te_pa_gen_firm_price_<good>) and whether the market imports and exports it.
te_pa_gen_read_good = {
	set_variable = { name = te_pa_g_$SLOT$_good value = $IDX$ }
	set_variable = { name = te_pa_g_$SLOT$_pricier value = te_pa_gen_firm_price_$GOOD$ }
	if = {
		limit = { owner = { market = { mg:$GOOD$ = { market_goods_imports > 0 } } } }
		set_variable = { name = te_pa_g_$SLOT$_imported value = 1 }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = te_pa_g_$SLOT$_imported value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { owner = { market = { mg:$GOOD$ = { market_goods_exports > 0 } } } }
		set_variable = { name = te_pa_g_$SLOT$_exported value = 1 }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = te_pa_g_$SLOT$_exported value = 0 }
	}
}

# Scope: a company. One technology of its sector: counted in te_pa_g_tech_gap when the home country lacks it
# and can research it, te_pa_gen_tech_held_bonus more while te_pa_gen_tech_cache found some country holding it.
te_pa_gen_tech_check = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			owner = {
				NOT = { has_technology_researched = $TECH$ }
				can_research = $TECH$
			}
		}
		change_variable = { name = te_pa_g_tech_gap add = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_variable = te_pa_gen_tech_held_$N$ }
			change_variable = { name = te_pa_g_tech_gap add = te_pa_gen_tech_held_bonus }
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. Whether some country holds one technology, into the global te_pa_gen_tech_held_<N>.
te_pa_gen_tech_cache_one = {
	if = {
		limit = { any_country = { has_technology_researched = $TECH$ } }
		set_global_variable = { name = te_pa_gen_tech_held_$N$ value = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_pa_gen_tech_held_$N$ }
		remove_global_variable = te_pa_gen_tech_held_$N$
	}
}

# Scope: a company. Its stances on the covered laws (te_pa_gen_stance_<law>), with the index of the law each
# comes from (the table's order, from 1; 0 none), for the reason line and te_pa_row_reason_law:
#   te_pa_g_law_worst, _worst_law        the law in force that burdens the sector most (stance <= 0)
#   te_pa_g_law_best, _best_law          the law it could move to that favors it most (stance >= 0;
#                                        te_pa_gen_law_open_<law>)
#   te_pa_g_law_enacting, _enacting_law  the law the home country is enacting, when covered
# The stances read the firm's own record too (te_pa_share, te_pa_posture, te_pa_lab, te_pa_campaign_total),
# so run it after the turn has written those.
te_pa_gen_law_pick = {
	set_variable = { name = te_pa_g_law_worst value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = te_pa_g_law_worst_law value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = te_pa_g_law_best value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = te_pa_g_law_best_law value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = te_pa_g_law_enacting value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = te_pa_g_law_enacting_law value = 0 }
	te_pa_gen_law_pick_in_force = { LAW = law_traditionalism N = 1 }
	te_pa_gen_law_pick_in_force = { LAW = law_interventionism N = 2 }
	te_pa_gen_law_pick_in_force = { LAW = law_agrarianism N = 3 }

# Scope: a company. One covered law in force: kept when it burdens the sector more than the worst so far.
te_pa_gen_law_pick_in_force = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			owner = { has_law = law_type:$LAW$ }
			te_pa_gen_stance_$LAW$ < var:te_pa_g_law_worst
		}
		set_variable = { name = te_pa_g_law_worst value = te_pa_gen_stance_$LAW$ }
		set_variable = { name = te_pa_g_law_worst_law value = $N$ }
	}
}

# Scope: a company. One covered law the home country could move to: kept when it favors the sector more than
# the best so far.
te_pa_gen_law_pick_open = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			te_pa_gen_stance_$LAW$ > var:te_pa_g_law_best
			owner = { te_pa_gen_law_open_$LAW$ = yes }
		}
		set_variable = { name = te_pa_g_law_best value = te_pa_gen_stance_$LAW$ }
		set_variable = { name = te_pa_g_law_best_law value = $N$ }
	}
}

# Scope: a company. One covered law, when the home country is enacting it.
te_pa_gen_law_pick_enacting = {
	if = {
		limit = { owner = { is_enacting_law = law_type:$LAW$ } }
		set_variable = { name = te_pa_g_law_enacting value = te_pa_gen_stance_$LAW$ }
		set_variable = { name = te_pa_g_law_enacting_law value = $N$ }
	}
}

# Scope: a country. The tally behind a self-check of the open-law reading (te_pa_gen_law_open_<law>):
# te_pa_sc_law_open counts the covered laws not in force, with one unlocking technology and no
# can_enact, that law_is_available reads as open; te_pa_sc_law_open_untech those of them whose
# technology the country lacks. OK: open >= 1 and untech = 0 (law_is_available reads the law's
# technology, so it reads the rest of its unlocking too). BROKEN: untech > 0, and the open-law reading
# rests on the technology lines te_pa_gen_law_open_<law> adds beside it. Task 2 logs it once a game.
te_pa_gen_law_selfcheck = {
	set_variable = { name = te_pa_sc_law_open value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = te_pa_sc_law_open_untech value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_law = law_type:law_interventionism }
			any_law = { type = law_type:law_interventionism law_is_available = yes }
		}
		change_variable = { name = te_pa_sc_law_open add = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_technology_researched = manufacturies } }
			change_variable = { name = te_pa_sc_law_open_untech add = 1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_law = law_type:law_agrarianism }
			any_law = { type = law_type:law_agrarianism law_is_available = yes }
		}
		change_variable = { name = te_pa_sc_law_open add = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_technology_researched = romanticism } }
			change_variable = { name = te_pa_sc_law_open_untech add = 1 }
		}

	if = {

# Scope: a company, from the turn when the firm has no seat or its seat has left the country (te_pa_core_effects.txt).
# The firm's seat (§ 4.5): the incorporated home state with the most levels of its type's building types, saved as
# scope:te_pa_seat_pick (unset when no incorporated home state holds one; the turn falls back on the capital).
# Script has no link from a company to its headquarters' state (§ 16, probe 11: the 1.15 event targets give a
# company only executive, owner, type, prosperity and weekly_prosperity_change; its regional headquarters are
# iterable, its main one is not), so the seat is the spec's fallback. te_pa_gen_seat_levels_<type> is the order.
te_pa_gen_seat_pick = {
	if = {
		limit = { is_company_type = company_type:company_a_markwald_and_company }
		owner = {
			ordered_scope_state = {
				limit = {
					is_incorporated = yes
					OR = {
						has_building = building_rice_farm
						has_building = building_port
						has_building = building_markwald_bangkok_rice_mill
					}
				}
				order_by = te_pa_gen_seat_levels_company_a_markwald_and_company
				position = 0
				check_range_bounds = no
				save_scope_as = te_pa_seat_pick
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { is_company_type = company_type:company_airbus }

# The trust and the foundation (spec §§ 5.5, 6.1; te_pa_trust_effects.txt calls these). A firm type's modifiers
# (te_pa_gen_modifiers.txt): te_pa_cartel_<type> names its firm, for an open or exposed cartel;
# te_pa_cartel_secret_<type> names none, for a secret one (§ 4.6: its effect is seen, its author is not);
# te_pa_found_<type> is its foundation's, on a state.
#
# Scope: a company holding a cartel, from the quarter, with its owner as ROOT (an add_modifier's multiplier
# resolves against ROOT). Replaces the firm's cartel modifier: the known or the secret one by te_pa_cartel_known,
# at te_pa_cartel_mult (strength over 100), which a country variable a type holds (te_pa_cm_<type>), since a
# multiplier is read again after it is applied and two firms' cartels can't share one.
te_pa_gen_cartel_apply = {
	save_scope_as = te_pa_gen_cartel_firm
	if = {
		limit = { is_company_type = company_type:company_a_markwald_and_company }
		owner = {
			remove_modifier = te_pa_cartel_company_a_markwald_and_company
			remove_modifier = te_pa_cartel_secret_company_a_markwald_and_company
			set_variable = { name = te_pa_cm_company_a_markwald_and_company value = scope:te_pa_gen_cartel_firm.var:te_pa_cartel_mult }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_pa_cartel_known ?= 1 }
			owner = { add_modifier = { name = te_pa_cartel_company_a_markwald_and_company multiplier = var:te_pa_cm_company_a_markwald_and_company } }
		}
		else = {
			owner = { add_modifier = { name = te_pa_cartel_secret_company_a_markwald_and_company multiplier = var:te_pa_cm_company_a_markwald_and_company } }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { is_company_type = company_type:company_airbus }
		owner = {
			remove_modifier = te_pa_cartel_company_airbus
			remove_modifier = te_pa_cartel_secret_company_airbus
			set_variable = { name = te_pa_cm_company_airbus value = scope:te_pa_gen_cartel_firm.var:te_pa_cartel_mult }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_pa_cartel_known ?= 1 }
			owner = { add_modifier = { name = te_pa_cartel_company_airbus multiplier = var:te_pa_cm_company_airbus } }
		}
		else = {
			owner = { add_modifier = { name = te_pa_cartel_secret_company_airbus multiplier = var:te_pa_cm_company_airbus } }
		}
	}
	else_if = {

	else_if = {

			remove_modifier = te_pa_cartel_secret_company_ynchausti_y_compania
			set_variable = { name = te_pa_cm_company_ynchausti_y_compania value = scope:te_pa_gen_cartel_firm.var:te_pa_cartel_mult }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_pa_cartel_known ?= 1 }
			owner = { add_modifier = { name = te_pa_cartel_company_ynchausti_y_compania multiplier = var:te_pa_cm_company_ynchausti_y_compania } }
		}
		else = {
			owner = { add_modifier = { name = te_pa_cartel_secret_company_ynchausti_y_compania multiplier = var:te_pa_cm_company_ynchausti_y_compania } }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { is_company_type = company_type:company_yoyodyne_propulsion }
		owner = {
			remove_modifier = te_pa_cartel_company_yoyodyne_propulsion
			remove_modifier = te_pa_cartel_secret_company_yoyodyne_propulsion
			set_variable = { name = te_pa_cm_company_yoyodyne_propulsion value = scope:te_pa_gen_cartel_firm.var:te_pa_cartel_mult }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_pa_cartel_known ?= 1 }
			owner = { add_modifier = { name = te_pa_cartel_company_yoyodyne_propulsion multiplier = var:te_pa_cm_company_yoyodyne_propulsion } }
		}
		else = {
			owner = { add_modifier = { name = te_pa_cartel_secret_company_yoyodyne_propulsion multiplier = var:te_pa_cm_company_yoyodyne_propulsion } }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { is_company_type = company_type:company_zastava }
		owner = {
			remove_modifier = te_pa_cartel_company_zastava
			remove_modifier = te_pa_cartel_secret_company_zastava
			set_variable = { name = te_pa_cm_company_zastava value = scope:te_pa_gen_cartel_firm.var:te_pa_cartel_mult }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:te_pa_cartel_known ?= 1 }
			owner = { add_modifier = { name = te_pa_cartel_company_zastava multiplier = var:te_pa_cm_company_zastava } }
		}
		else = {
			owner = { add_modifier = { name = te_pa_cartel_secret_company_zastava multiplier = var:te_pa_cm_company_zastava } }
		}
	}
}

# Scope: a country. Takes every firm's cartel modifiers off it: the teardown (the rule switched off), which
# also reaches a modifier whose firm has gone.
te_pa_gen_cartel_remove_all = {
	remove_modifier = te_pa_cartel_company_a_markwald_and_company
	remove_modifier = te_pa_cartel_secret_company_a_markwald_and_company
	remove_modifier = te_pa_cartel_company_airbus
	remove_modifier = te_pa_cartel_secret_company_airbus

# Scope: a state, from the state pulse (te_pa_state_monthly: ROOT is the state, which an add_modifier's
# multiplier resolves against). Replaces the state's foundation modifier, the one of the type numbered
# te_pa_st_found_type (te_pa_g_type), at te_pa_st_found_mult, while te_pa_st_found_str is above 0; takes it off
# otherwise.
te_pa_gen_found_apply = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:te_pa_st_found_type ?= 1 }
		remove_modifier = te_pa_found_company_a_markwald_and_company
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = te_pa_st_found_str
				var:te_pa_st_found_str > 0
			}
			add_modifier = { name = te_pa_found_company_a_markwald_and_company multiplier = var:te_pa_st_found_mult }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:te_pa_st_found_type ?= 2 }
		remove_modifier = te_pa_found_company_airbus

			limit = {
				has_variable = te_pa_st_found_str

		}

# Scope: a company endowing a foundation (te_pa_do_endow, § 4.5): the incorporated home state with the most
# levels of its building types that holds no other firm's foundation, as the seat is picked, saved as
# scope:te_pa_found_pick (unset when there is none).
te_pa_gen_found_pick = {
	if = {
		limit = { is_company_type = company_type:company_a_markwald_and_company }
		owner = {
			ordered_scope_state = {
				limit = {
					is_incorporated = yes
					NOT = { has_variable = te_pa_st_found_str }
					OR = {
						has_building = building_rice_farm
						has_building = building_port
						has_building = building_markwald_bangkok_rice_mill
					}
				}
				order_by = te_pa_gen_seat_levels_company_a_markwald_and_company
				position = 0
				check_range_bounds = no
				save_scope_as = te_pa_found_pick
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { is_company_type = company_type:company_airbus }
		owner = {
			ordered_scope_state = {
				limit = {
					is_incorporated = yes
					NOT = { has_variable = te_pa_st_found_str }
					OR = {
						has_building = building_aerospace_industry
						has_building = building_motor_industry
						has_building = building_airbus_lagardere_plant
					}
				}
				order_by = te_pa_gen_seat_levels_company_airbus
				position = 0
				check_range_bounds = no
				save_scope_as = te_pa_found_pick
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { is_company_type = company_type:company_ajinomoto }
		owner = {
			ordered_scope_state = {
				limit = {
					is_incorporated = yes

					OR = {
						has_building = building_food_industry

# Scope: a company (te_pa_do_expand, Dominance's verb below the cartel's share, § 6.1 stage 1: the firm builds in
# its sector). Queues one private level of its main building type at its seat, or of the next of its types the
# seat can take a level of (Sector.expand's order). start_privately_funded_building_construction takes a literal
# building and queues private construction for the state's owner, which its investment pool pays for as for the
# engine's own (scripting_best_practices.md), so it spends no funds (§ 4.3). te_pa_gen_can_expand says whether
# there is one.
te_pa_gen_expand = {
	if = {
		limit = { is_company_type = company_type:company_a_markwald_and_company }
		var:te_pa_seat ?= {
			if = {
				limit = { any_scope_building = { is_building_type = building_rice_farm can_queue_building_levels = 1 } }
				start_privately_funded_building_construction = building_rice_farm
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { any_scope_building = { is_building_type = building_port can_queue_building_levels = 1 } }
				start_privately_funded_building_construction = building_port
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { any_scope_building = { is_building_type = building_markwald_bangkok_rice_mill can_queue_building_levels = 1 } }
				start_privately_funded_building_construction = building_markwald_bangkok_rice_mill
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { is_company_type = company_type:company_airbus }
		var:te_pa_seat ?= {
			if = {
				limit = { any_scope_building = { is_building_type = building_aerospace_industry can_queue_building_levels = 1 } }
				start_privately_funded_building_construction = building_aerospace_industry
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { any_scope_building = { is_building_type = building_motor_industry can_queue_building_levels = 1 } }
				start_privately_funded_building_construction = building_motor_industry
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { any_scope_building = { is_building_type = building_airbus_lagardere_plant can_queue_building_levels = 1 } }
				start_privately_funded_building_construction = building_airbus_lagardere_plant
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { is_company_type = company_type:company_ajinomoto }
		var:te_pa_seat ?= {
			if = {
				limit = { any_scope_building = { is_building_type = building_food_industry can_queue_building_levels = 1 } }
				start_privately_funded_building_construction = building_food_industry
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { any_scope_building = { is_building_type = building_synthetics_plant_sugar can_queue_building_levels = 1 } }
				start_privately_funded_building_construction = building_synthetics_plant_sugar
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { any_scope_building = { is_building_type = building_synthetics_plant_drinks can_queue_building_levels = 1 } }
				start_privately_funded_building_construction = building_synthetics_plant_drinks
